notes.title: Today the console version of “Snezinka” is released!
notes.content:
Snezhinka, the sequel to Marfusha, will release on the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S on February 13.

https://playism.com/en/game/snezhinka/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39866449/0326f6b150a2f421f32750f9f4f78a53eb7565d4.png[/img]

It is thanks to all of you who played the Steam version that a small game produced by an individual was able to be distributed on three different platforms.

Thank you very much!
We look forward to your continued support for this series.

notes.title: Localization fixes
notes.content: Fixed a localization error in the Korean language.

notes.title: Additional language support update
notes.content:
Added Korean to supported languages.
Fixed a bug in the achievements.

notes.title: ver1.2.0
notes.content:
Medium updates

Fixed the problem of not being able to proceed from the warning screen due to save data corruption.
Adjusted the balance of Challenge Mode.
Slightly improved the status of Alibina and Strelka at Lv.3.
Changed the playable abilities of Alibina and Bion.
Adjusted the effect of the card "I want money" from 10 to 15.
Fixed the problem that the appearance rate of the electric gun/cerberus card is abnormally low.
Fixed the problem that the achievements of friends and guns are released.
Improved security measures.
Fixed other minor bugs.
Added a dog to the DLC art book as an extra material.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

-Original text-
・セーブデータ破損により注意書き画面から進まなくなる問題を修正
・チャレンジモードのバランスを調整
・アリビナ/ストレルカLv3時のステータスを微強化
・アリビナ/ビオンのプレイアブル時の能力を変更
・カード”お金が欲しい”の効果を10から15に調整
・電熱砲/ケルベロスカードの出現率が異常に低い問題を修正
・仲間/銃の実績が解放されてしまう不具合を修正
・セキュリティ対策の強化
・その他、軽微な不具合の修正
・DLCアートブックのおまけ素材に犬を追加

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented some events from occurring
Fixed the initialization process of the number of cards acquired.

notes.title: ver1.1.0
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.0
New features added
Added the ending reminiscence function.
Added the ability to redeem cards with money.
Added the ability to redeem cards with money. - Added the ability to switch languages from the settings.
The introduction screen changes according to the status of the ending collection.


Addition of new cards
Spike
Pile Shot

Adjusted weapon balance
All yellow card weapons have been rebalanced.
All blue card weapons have been enhanced.

Enemy Strength Adjustment
Enemy stats for the 90th day have been reduced.
Enemy stats for the 100th day have been reduced.
Reduced the stamina of the large suicide bomber in Challenge Mode.

Changes to Enemy Appearance Patterns
Enemy appearance patterns have been changed in some stages of the main mode.

The save function has been modified.
To prevent ranking fraud, the save function has been modified.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
The progress of the previous version can not be taken over from this version due to the modification.
The progress of the previous version cannot be carried over from this version, and will be reset.

A new ranking system for new regulations has been established.
You can check the past rankings from the Steam Community page.


Many other bug fixes have been made.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: ver1.0.0.6
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the SE of stage 1 did not follow the sound settings.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.6
notes.content:
Bug fixes
Fixed an issue where the spacebar would not work properly due to an abnormally high frame rate.
Fixed a bug where the player would become invincible after firing the stage 2 boss beam.
Fixed a part of Chinese localization.

Changed specifications.
ESC key can be used to pause the game.
Changed so that the coordinates of the in-game cursor and mouse cursor are the same.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.5
notes.content:
Added a "phone" to show the status in the dormitory.

Fixed some minor bugs and typos.
Fixed all text in the English version of the quarters.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.4
notes.content:
Specification changes
Decreased the rate at which rationing machines fail, and increased the rate at which Attack UP & Rapid Fire UP appear.

Bug fixes
Fixed a problem where the EN version of paid leave was being displayed in place of the electric heat gun.
Belka Bion's additional installations will now remain in place beyond the next day.
Fixed a bug that prevented medium-sized aircraft from attacking anti-aircraft turrets.

Localization fixes
Fixed a typo in the buttons on the collection screen.
Fixed an issue where the EN version of Laika's greeting was in Japanese.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.3
notes.content: Fixed a bug in Challenge Mode that allowed installations to be carried over when restarting.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed a bug.
　Fixed a bug where using the refrigerator in the quarters would cause the magazine size to exceed the limit.
　Fixed a bug that allowed disposable weapons and installations to be carried over when the main mode game over.
　Fixed a bug that allowed dogs to be carried over in main mode.
　Fixed a number of minor notations.

Changed specifications
　Changed the way that the magazine is loaded to the maximum from the beginning in the "All You Can Shoot Chance Card" mode.
　Changed so that you can restart from the pause screen in all screens of main mode and challenge mode.
　Added a back button to the Challenge Mode character selection screen.

Localization
　Chinese Fixed the translation of the light machine gun.
　English Fixed the "Skip" button in the event being left in Japanese.

DLC
    Added character materials for compatibility bonus to bonus image materials.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.2
notes.content: Fixed a bug in version 1.0.0.2 that prevented the Day 90 boss from taking damage, which only occurred in the JP version.

notes.title: ver1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Fixed bugs
The description of the electric heat gun does not appear in the main mode, card selection scene.
The HP gauge of the enemy is covered by the HP gauge of the defense target and cannot be seen.
Going into the back side of the boss on the 90th day.
Localization of "equipped weapons" in Chinese.
Typos in the artbook

Changed specifications
Objects that can be placed across dates are now clearly stated in the description.

We will continue to fix bugs and reflect your requests in the future.

notes.title: Ending Scene Unprogress Bug Fixed
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented the ending scene from progressing.
The cause is under investigation, and the SE will be disabled in the ending scene until the investigation is completed.
